effect: Fat digestion completed the meal goal. The result distinguishes bile’s role in dispersing fat from lipase’s role in breaking it apart.
reaction: That distinction was useful and clearer than some earlier results.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fat digestion was most worthwhile because it showed what bile and lipase each contribute, including that bile is not an enzyme.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the organs felt repetitive: the required slots made the choices straightforward, and the pancreas fitting added no further explanation.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that bile disperses fat but is not an enzyme.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the order of fitting the organs was a routine choice among compatible options.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the products cross the intestinal lining, although I would hope for fewer repetitive fittings and more explanation of the processes.
